verdict.rationale: Datalab's hosted API shows no region or residency selector. Data location can only be controlled through its Enterprise on-prem option, which runs its models on customer-controlled (including air-gapped) infrastructure and is deployable via a Helm chart. That is a first-party route to residency, but it is gated behind an Enterprise contract and self-hosting. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted cloud service, documented data-residency or storage-location guarantees for hosted file storage, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Customers can run our models on infrastructure they control with an Enterprise contract.
Require data privacy/operate in highly-regulated environments
Enterprise adds running on your own infrastructure (air-gapped) with SSO.
A Helm chart is available for deploying the container on Kubernetes clusters.
